invite4: {host} challenges you! The same sixteen Pokémon for both of you: the first to find all four groups wins.
invite5: {host} challenges you to a 5×5 board! The same twenty-five Pokémon for both of you: the first to find all five groups wins.
about4: The same sixteen Pokémon for both of you. Find the four groups of four before your opponent does.
about5: The same twenty-five Pokémon for both of you (a 5×5 board). Find the five groups of five before your opponent does.
inviteShare: Race me at PokéConnections! Same {n} Pokémon, first to find the {size} groups wins.

rules.race4: The same sixteen Pokémon and four hidden groups for both of you. The first to find all four wins.
rules.race5: The same twenty-five Pokémon and five hidden groups for both of you (a 5×5 board). The first to find all five wins.
rules.mistakesText: Each mistake adds {s} seconds to your time, so a quick but sloppy solve can still lose. {size} mistakes and you're out.
rules.winningText: The lower time (penalties included) wins. If you're both out, or {min} minutes pass, more groups found wins, then fewer mistakes. You see your opponent's groups as colours only.

announce.left: {left, plural, one {{left} mistake left.} other {{left} mistakes left.}}
announce.repeat: Already guessed. That doesn't cost a mistake.

lead4: Sixteen Pokémon, four groups. Each mistake costs {s} seconds.
lead5: Twenty-five Pokémon, five groups. Each mistake costs {s} seconds.

reason.bothYou: You solved it in {a} to {b}, penalties included.
reason.bothThem: {name} solved it in {a} to {b}, penalties included.
reason.firstYou: You found all {size, select, 5 {five} other {four}} groups first.
reason.firstYouOut: You found all {size, select, 5 {five} other {four}} groups first; {name} ran out of mistakes.
reason.firstThem: {name} found all {size, select, 5 {five} other {four}} groups first.
reason.firstThemOut: {name} found all {size, select, 5 {five} other {four}} groups first; you ran out of mistakes.
reason.moreYou: Nobody solved it: You found more groups, {a} to {b}.
reason.moreThem: Nobody solved it: {name} found more groups, {a} to {b}.
reason.fewerYou: Nobody solved it, and you made fewer mistakes.
reason.fewerThem: Nobody solved it, and {name} made fewer mistakes.

share.drew: PokéIQ PokéConnections duel: I drew with {name}! {score}
share.lost: PokéIQ PokéConnections duel: I lost to {name}! {score}

rematchNote4: A rematch keeps the trainers, with sixteen new Pokémon. It starts when you both press it.
rematchNote5: A rematch keeps the trainers, with twenty-five new Pokémon (still 5×5). It starts when you both press it.
